body:
Founder: 'can we implement sprays? ... export to spray goes to sprays registry same treatment ... we need a nock sprays interface right now just to set the default.' New shankpit_sprays table + SprayStore (create/list/set-default/delete), first spray auto-becomes default. Projects tab gained 'Export to Spray' (posts the project's own rendered PNG straight to the registry). New Sprays tab: grid + set-default + delete. 6 new tests pass, full suite green. Native sprays menu + the real 'T' wall-decal mechanism are separate, deferred follow-up, named not dropped. Live-verified against the real production DB (create/default/list/public-endpoints), zero residue left. Commit 13871d6.

⚓ ☃
title: Ship SHANKPIT sprays backend + NOCK UI
